==Biography==
Before joining Dignitas, IWillDominate played for [[Complexity]]/Too Tricky. On December 4, 2012, all of his accounts were permanently banned from League of Legends due to toxic behavior and he was subsequently suspended from the League Championship Series for one year.<ref>[http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?t=2864421 IWillDominate Tribunal Permaban & eSports Competition Ruling] ''na.leagueoflegends.com''</ref> 

IWillDominate took it as an opportunity for self-improvement and has since reformed from his formerly toxic ways.<ref>[http://www.reignofgaming.net/blogs/tuck-esports-inquirer/23473-iwilldominate-moving-into-curse-house-riot-has Tuck's eSports Inquirer interview with IWDominate] ''ReignOfGaming.net''</ref> His quest to redemption started with the creation of a new account with the name "IWDomínate" and the subsequent climb to a 2.2k Elo rating. Upon reaching that milestone, he started streaming.<ref>[http://twitter.com/digDominate/status/280089156770754560 IWillDominate begins streaming] ''twitter.com''</ref>

Although IWillDominate had been banned from the LCS, he was still able to compete in other events unrelated to LCS.

On July 7, 2013, around one week after losing to [[FXOpen e-Sports]] 1-2 in the semifinals of the [[2013 MLG Pro Circuit/Spring/Championship#Spring Championship 2|MLG Spring Championship]], I Will Dominate announced his break from competitive play. He will still be living at the curse house as coach/analyst for Curse Academy and backup coach for [[Team Curse]].<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czRN-Py9EXc IWillDominate Announcement] ''youtube.com''</ref>

In October 2013, Dominate would rejoin the the competitive scene as a player as it was announced he would be the jungler for [[Curse Gaming]].<ref>[http://www.teamcurse.net/divisions/league-of-legends/team-curse Team Curse Roster Changes] ''teamcurse.net''</ref>

On November 7, 2013, IWillDominate's LCS ban was officially lifted.<ref>[http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=42838999#42838999 eSports Competition Rulings: Suspensions of Linak and Rayt3ch] ''forums.na.leagueoflegends.com''</ref>

===2015 Season===
Prior to the start of the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Season|spring LCS split]], Team Curse merged with the Team Liquid organization and rebranded under the name [[Team Liquid]]. After a few swaps between [[Keith]] and [[Piglet]] as their AD carry, the team ended the season with a 9-9 record and qualified for [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Playoffs|playoffs]] with the sixth seed after defeating [[Team 8]] in a tiebreaker game. In the playoffs, Liquid beat [[Counter Logic Gaming|CLG]] 3-0 in the quarterfinals before falling to [[Cloud9]] 3-2 in the semifinals; in the third-place match, Liquid finally broke the "fourth-place curse" that stopped them from placing higher than fourth place in any event that had persisted since they were Team Curse and took down [[Team Impulse]] 3-2.

Team Liquid finished the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Summer Season|summer split round robin]] in first place after winning a tiebreaker match over Counter Logic Gaming - [[LCS Teams Timeline|the first team]] other than TSM or Cloud9 to place first in an NA LCS round robin. However, in the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Summer Playoffs|playoffs]], they lost immediately in the semifinals to TSM, making them also the first team to finish first in an NA LCS round robin but not make the playoff finals. A CLG victory over TSM in the playoff finals sent Team Liquid to the [[2015 Season North America Regional Finals|regional finals]] instead of giving them a direct seed to [[2015 Season World Championship|Worlds]] via [[2015 Season/Championship Points|Championship Points]], and in the gauntlet they lost to underdogs Cloud9, ending their post-season abruptly.

===2016 Season===
After playing one game in the [[League Championship Series/North America/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 NA LCS Spring Season]], IWDominate announced his retirement from competitive ''League of Legends''. He stayed with the organization to act as a positional coach to his successor [[Dardoch]] and temporarily substitute for [[Team Liquid Academy]] in the [[NA Challenger Series/2016 Season/Spring Season|NACS]].<ref>[http://blog.instantesports.com/iwdominate-retires-professional-league-legends/ IWDominate Retires from Professional League of Legends] ''blog.instantesports.com''</ref>
